name: Calling People Fools
overview: Scripture reveals that calling people fools is deeply connected to their rejection of God and His wisdom. The Psalms declare that fools deny God's existence and live corruptly, engaging in abominable works (Psalms 14:1; 53:1), while foolish people blaspheme the Lord's name (Psalm 74:18). Proverbs further teaches that fools despise wisdom and instruction, often hiding hatred and slander behind their words (Proverbs 1:7; 10:18), and stubbornly trust their own misguided judgment rather than heeding wise counsel (Proverbs 12:15). Thus, the biblical portrayal of fools centers on their spiritual blindness, moral corruption, and rejection of divine truth.
